org.apache.xpath.functions

Class XSL3FunctionService

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.apache.xpath.functions.XSL3FunctionService

  • public class XSL3FunctionService
extends java.lang.Object
    This class definition, provides support to evaluate XPath schema constructor function calls, evaluating XPath named function references, and evaluating XSL stylesheet xsl:function calls.

      • evaluateXPathInlineFunction

        public XObject evaluateXPathInlineFunction(XPathInlineFunction xpathInlineFunction,
                                           java.util.List<java.lang.String> argList,
                                           XPathContext xctxt,
                                           java.util.List<XMLNSDecl> prefixTable,
                                           java.util.Vector varVector,
                                           int varGlobalSize,
                                           java.util.List<QName> xpathVarList,
                                           java.lang.String xslDynFuncCallVarName)
                                    throws javax.xml.transform.TransformerException
        Method definition to evaluate an XPath inline function expression.
        Parameters:
        xpathInlineFunction - An XPath compiled inline function reference object
        argList - A list of XPath string values for argument information of inline function reference.
        xctxt - An XPath context object
        prefixTable - An XML prefix table list object reference containing an XSL context namespace binding information.
        varVector - Collection of variable names within an XSL current evaluation context.
        varGlobalSize - An integer value to resolve variable names within an XSL current evaluation context.
        xpathVarList - List of variable names to support resolving XSL run-time XPath expression evaluation.
        xslDynFuncCallVarName - If this method is called to evaluate an XPath dynamic function call, this argument contains name of the variable referring to an XPath function that will be called.
        Returns:
        The result of evaluation of an XPath inline function expression.
        Throws:
        javax.xml.transform.TransformerException
